reading: The sketch lays out a flight-search results page: a full-width top bar for origin/destination/date/passenger/search controls, a left filter panel with checkbox sections and a departure-time slider, a row of Best/Cheapest/Fastest summary cards, and a stacked list of 4 detailed flight result cards — all content fully specified by the typed notes.
